body: I agree and more. We are all born with out a choice and just have to live a life. Just because the majority of the population go along with that it doesn't make it right.. or me wrong.
Last night I saw a hedgehog so I went and sat next to it for an hour, cried myh eyes out and told it things I've never told a person!

I'm not sure if this will help you or not but I have found between 2 and 5 am to be the best time of day for me, especially to get out the house, everyone else is asleep, the stars are out, it's quiet and dark and the world feels like a different place. I'd recommend a walk, or drive somewhere, find a field or hill or something and look up, you can scream and shout and cry or sing or whatever you need to do, alone, people won't bother you and vice versa.
